kind: full-field Make Masks restoration acceptance (real GUI chain, CPU only)

environment.backend: isolated Cellpose 3.1.1.3 venv (torch 2.14.1+cpu) installed via _install_backend into a scratch SPACR_BACKENDS_DIR, not the repo

data_note: Public Host-Pathogen example field, channel 0 (THP1 Hoechst), from spaCR's example-data cache; plane SHA256 equals the 2026-09-24 full-field receipt's source_sha256, so it is the same field on a different path
method: MakeMasksScreen with no stubs: nuclei weights, diameter 25 px, Denoise; real model load; Compare on the whole field (no magnifier box); Apply; then diameter 30 and, 0.5 s into that whole-field restoration, 25.5 -- the applied cache must belong to 25.5; GUI detection source compared with direct _restore_plane on the same editor pixels; Otsu (_otsu_instances, min_area 20, fill holes, split) on restored and raw planes; chain provenance JSON round trip; Apply off. A 10 ms QTimer sampled event-loop gaps throughout.

stale_check.max_tick_gap_note: 0.51 s gap is the acceptance script's own deliberate time.sleep(0.5) on the GUI thread between the two diameter changes, not restoration work; every other phase stayed under 0.017 s

not_claimed: No segmentation-accuracy or biological-fidelity claim; the Otsu object-count difference (325 restored vs 365 raw) is descriptive only.
